title: T-GADE: Thermodynamical Generative-AI-Driven Evolution of LLM Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2609.12286v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Introducing large language models (LLMs) into evolutionary computation enables semantic generation of candidates, but the classical problem of maintaining population diversity remains. Inspired by the thermodynamical genetic algorithm (TDGA), we propose T-GADE (Thermodynamical Generative-AI-Driven Evolution of LLM Artifacts), an evolutionary computation framework extended through LLMs. T-GADE keeps the notions of a population and genetic operators, takes structured artifacts generated by an LLM as individuals, and implements crossover and mutation as LLM operators. It further introduces the HoxLM, an LLM that attempts self-repair of an individual after evaluation and before survival selection; two update schemes, generational and steady-state; and Fermi-type and Bose-type occupancy rules that define solution identity and whether duplicates are permitted. translated_title: T-GADE：基于热力学与生成式AI驱动的大语言模型产物进化
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）引入进化计算可以实现候选解的语义化生成，但维持种群多样性这一经典问题依然存在。受热力学遗传算法（TDGA）的启发，我们提出了T-GADE（Thermodynamical Generative-AI-Driven Evolution of LLM Artifacts），一种通过大语言模型扩展的进化计算框架。T-GADE保留了种群和遗传算子的概念，将LLM生成的结构化产物作为个体，并将交叉和变异实现为LLM算子。该框架进一步引入了HoxLM——一种在个体评估之后、存活选择之前尝试对个体进行自我修复的LLM；两种更新方案——代际更新和稳态更新；以及定义解的同一性及是否允许重复的费米型和玻色型占据规则。存活选择被统一为自由能 $F_T=\langle E\rangle - TS$ 的最小化。
tldr: 该论文提出T-GADE框架，将大语言模型作为交叉、变异等遗传算子嵌入受热力学遗传算法启发的进化计算框架中，通过自由能最小化的存活选择、HoxLM自修复机制以及费米/玻色型占据规则，来解决进化过程中维持种群多样性的经典难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes T-GADE, an evolutionary computation framework that employs LLMs as crossover and mutation operators inspired by thermodynamical genetic algorithms, addressing the classical challenge of maintaining population diversity through free-energy-minimizing survival selection, a self-repairing HoxLM, and Fermi/Bose-type occupancy rules.
